latest.summary: Soil conditions are balanced with neutral pH (6.85) and adequate moisture (32.4%). Nitrogen level is moderate and can support vegetative growth with light organic enrichment.

nitrogen.assessment: 48 mg/kg provides steady baseline nitrogen for cereal crops.

potassium.assessment: 115 mg/kg supports cellular turgor and drought resilience.

phMoistureAssessment.phAnalysis: pH 6.85 is within the optimal nutrient absorption range (6.0 - 7.5).
phMoistureAssessment.moistureAnalysis: Moisture at 32.4% is ideal for wheat, mustard, and leguminous crops.

recommendedActions.title: Maintain Organic Bio-Mass
recommendedActions.description: Apply well-decomposed vermicompost (1-2 tons/acre) before next sowing to sustain organic carbon.

recommendedActions.title: Soil Moisture Monitoring
recommendedActions.description: Schedule next irrigation cycle when moisture dips below 25%.

suggestedNextSteps: Perform secondary spot checks prior to fertilizer top-dressing.

projectMetadata.creator: Namit Kumar
projectMetadata.objective: Real-time industrial IoT soil nutrient, moisture, pH, and environmental intelligence platform designed to maximize crop yield, prevent soil degradation, and empower farmers with precision agronomy and AI intelligence.
projectMetadata.hardwareStack: ESP32 Dev Module, Industrial RS-485 Modbus NPK+Moisture+Temp+pH Soil Sensor, MAX485 TTL-to-RS485 transceiver, 16x2 I2C LCD Display
projectMetadata.pinoutDetails: ESP32 GPIO 16 (RX2), GPIO 17 (TX2), GPIO 4 (RE/DE Direction Control), I2C 0x27 for 16x2 LCD
projectMetadata.cloudStack: Firebase Realtime Database, Cloudflare Pages (Frontend), Render Backend (Node.js/Express) with Groq Llama 3.3 AI
